title: At lane start the harness gives the new session a roster; send_message refuses an id not in list_sessions
why: [13:31 CST Nov 15, triage] At lane start the harness gives the new session a roster (role, repo tag, id, status from list_sessions); roles and slugs stay in briefs; ids reach sessions by the harness, never hand-typed; send_message refuses an id not in list_sessions for the repo tag and prints the roster. Ruling own-ids-by-harness-roster (a lean). Guard or check: yes (unverified).
